fee_notes: Standard Initial Franchise Fee is $50,000 less any applicable Development Fee credits. For CPK Restaurants located at Non-Traditional Facilities, the fee is $30,000. The Development Fee is $25,000 multiplied by the number of CPK Restaurants agreed to be developed, and is credited against the Initial Franchise Fee. The Initial Franchise Fee is payable in one lump sum, fully earned when paid, and non-refundable. In the last fiscal year, the Initial Franchise Fee was waived for three Company-Operated Restaurants sold to a franchisee.
raw_excerpt: You must pay us an initial franchise fee in the amount of $50,000 ("Initial Franchise Fee") less any applicable Development Fee credits for your CPK Restaurant when you sign the Franchise Agreement. The Initial Franchise Fee for CPK Restaurants located at Non-Traditional Facilities is $30,000. The Initial Franchise Fee is payable in one lump sum, is fully earned when paid, and is not refundable.
